== June 2004 council page ==
The council.htm capture of 3 June 2004 names Greg Anderson, Jim Colson, Mitch Velasco, Jason Robinette and Doug Taylor. It also shows a vacant Card Design seat and a vacant Player Relations and Marketing seat. It does not name Nick Kolnik or Kevin Brownell. The New Advocates page captured the same day says those two had accepted. The roster table keeps the news dates. Ages and email addresses on the council pages were omitted.
